evidence.title: Push your ideas to the web | Netlify

name: Netlify
summary: Composable web platform for building, deploying and scaling sites, apps and AI agents, with previews, edge and CI/CD.
description: Hosted platform for shipping web projects: git-based continuous deployment, deploy previews, a global CDN and edge network, serverless and edge functions, managed Postgres and blob storage, and agent infrastructure (Agent Runners and an AI Gateway to OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini). Projects publish to a production URL with custom domains and SSL; documentation ships as llms.txt and markdown pages for agents.
contains: free tier with 300 credits; Personal $9/month; Pro $20/month; Enterprise custom
deploy from AI prompts, Git, API or drag and drop
Agent Runners run AI coding agents against your repo
AI Gateway proxies OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini without provider API keys
managed Postgres database and blob storage built in
deploy previews, firewall traffic rules and global CDN
documentation published as llms.txt and markdown pages for agents
